caption: The drawing depicts a metal object with a long, twisted vertical shaft ending in a light brown wooden handle at the top, which has a small loop or ring attached to its end. The main body of the object is an elongated, shallow basket-like structure, primarily composed of dark metal. It is supported by three downward-pointing legs attached to the bottom. Along the length of the basket, there are eight evenly spaced looped designs formed from the metal, resembling scrolls or spirals, attached in pairs to the frame. A thinner metal chain runs along the upper edge parallel to the basket's rim. The composition is centered on a pale, neutral background with no additional objects or scenery present. The color palette consists mainly of shades of brown and grey, with subtle highlights and shadows indicating the material and three-dimensional form of the object.
title: Toaster
